source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Whenever a **DAMNED** unit of yours that has [Dark Pacts](vsdata:ability/chaos-space-marines.dark-pacts) gets picked to make a [Normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move) or [Advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or to declare a charge, other than one that came in from Reserves this turn, you can have it make a Desperate Pact. If it does, its models get +2" M and its [Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step) get +2, for the rest of the phase.

**Desperate Pacts**: before anything from a Desperate Pact resolves, the unit making it takes a [Leadership test](vsdata:core-rule/leadership-rolls); on a fail, it takes D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds).
